name: La Suite numérique
description: European sovereign-workplace theme (MinBZK/mijn-bureau EDIC bundle) — Cunningham design tokens (MIT), self-hosted Inter, brand blue-violet #4844AD. No La Suite/state logo bundled (trademark).

font.note: Reserved for French State bodies. The bytes ship behind the admin acknowledgement gate (css/systems/lasuite/marianne.css, AGREEMENT-MARIANNE.md); without that acknowledgement the family resolves through local() only and Inter carries the page.

name: La Frankendesk
description: Conduction's own brand on the La Suite look. It keeps every lasuite colour and adds the La Frankendesk logo. A layer for public portals adds the footer, hero, cards and spacing. Violet #4844AD from the Cunningham tokens (MIT), set in self-hosted Inter.

name: Cunningham (blue base)
description: The published Cunningham design system (MIT, @openfun/cunningham-tokens) as distributed — blue base (brand-650 #1A509F, the same scale step the shared bridge/element-overrides derive --color-primary from for lasuite's violet #4844AD), self-hosted Inter. Secondary/optional sibling of lasuite: same generated token base, without the deployed violet La Suite brand override. No logo bundled.

font.note: Reserved for French State bodies. The bytes ship behind the admin acknowledgement gate (css/systems/lasuite/marianne.css, AGREEMENT-MARIANNE.md); without that acknowledgement the family resolves through local() only and Inter carries the page.
